Callout.Name: Car Meet Nuisance
Callout.Message: Large car meet blocking a retail park.
Callout.Advisory: Around fifteen vehicles, engines revving, no racing yet.

Script.Line: I am parked. Everybody here is parked.
Nobody is racing. We are stood around talking.
It is a car park. That is what a car park is for.

Lines.Approach: Fifteen cars and nobody is moving. They will scatter the moment you arrive - which is half the problem.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
